description: Spring Boot helps you to create Spring-powered, production-grade applications and services with absolute minimum fuss.

latest_release.body:
## :star: New Features

- Refine forwarded header support [#52800](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/issues/52800)
- Deprecate Apache Pulsar support [#52752](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/issues/52752)

## :lady_beetle: Bug Fixes

- Properties migrator does not migrate some properties renamed in 4.0 [#52809](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/issues/52809)
- Reactive web servers no longer use forwarded headers on a cloud platform after #52800 [#52806](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/pull/52806)
- Class loading fails with 'Zip file closed' can still be thrown under concurrent access [#52803](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/pull/52803)
- Auto-configured PulsarTransactionManager is not customized by TransactionManagerCustomizers [#52783](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/issues/52783)
- InspectedContent records the wrong size when a writer writes a range of bytes [#52781](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/issues/52781)
- PostgreSQL database names in Docker Compose JDBC URLs are not URL encoded [#52779](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/issues/52779)
- Encoded AMQP URI values are not decoded when no port is specified [#52777](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/issues/52777)
- SAML2 service provider metadata fails when the single logout binding is omitted [#52775](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/issues/52775)
- OriginTrackedPropertiesLoader drops an indented line after a document separator with trailing whitespace [#52773](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/issues/52773)
- Config tree imports referencing parent directories contain no data [#52769](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/issues/52769)
- Non-ASCII characters are corrupted when importing properties content with the env: prefix [#52764](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/issues/52764)
- Exception message in JvmMetricsAutoConfiguration.jvmThreadMetrics references incorrect class [#52754](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/pull/52754)
- Auto-configured GraphQL endpoint doesn't support HTTP OPTIONS requests [#52663](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/issues/52663)
- Metadata for management.health.amqprabbit.enabled is missing [#52637](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/issues/52637)
- Class loading fails with 'Zip file closed' while ClearCachesApplicationListener closes the jars of an executable jar [#52635](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/pull/52635)
- RabbitMQ address configuration properties don't support percent-encoded values in the URI [#52631](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/issues/52631)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Fix typo in webserver documentation [#52813](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/pull/52813)
- Add Rainbow Gum to community starters [#52807](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/pull/52807)
- Examples in "Auto-configured Spring REST Docs Tests With Mock MVC" are incomplete [#52662](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/issues/52662)

## :hammer: Dependency Upgrades

- Upgrade to [Couchbase Client 3.13.1](https://docs.couchbase.com/java-sdk/current/project-docs/sdk-release-notes.html) [#52805](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/issues/52805)
- Upgrade to [Elasticsearch Client 9.5.6](https://www.elastic.co/docs/release-notes/elasticsearch/clients/java/9-5-0) [#52713](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/issues/52713)
- Upgrade to [Hibernate 7.4.15.Final](https://github.com/hibernate/hibernate-orm/releases/tag/7.4.15) [#52746](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/issues/52746)
- Upgrade to [Jetty 12.1.15](https://github.com/jetty/jetty.project/releases/tag/jetty-12.1.15) [#52747](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/issues/52747)
- Upgrade to [Micrometer 1.18.0](https://github.com/micrometer-m
